newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Richina Pacific announces rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Richina Pacific announces rights issue.

text.p: Richina Pacific Ltd on Monday announced a one for two cash issue at 30 NZ cents per share to raise NZ$34.9 million before costs for new investment opportunities.
Richina said the prospects for further opportunities in the educational/entertainment sectors in aquariums were real, with a number of prospective sites and partners already identified.
The company said the directors believed that development of further aquarium projects should be equity-based. To provide funds for any opportunities which may arise it was announcing a cash issue.
It proposed issuing a prospectus on April 7 with rights trading commencing on that date and ending on April 29.
The issue was fully underwritten and would raise NZ$34.9 million before costs.

"The major shareholders have indicated they will be taking up their full entitlements. Total equity will be increased to approximately $139 million after completion of this issue which will further strengthen the company's balance sheet," Richina said.
It said following the cash issue, directors intended to consolidate shares on a one-for-five basis.

"This procedure will reduce shares on issue from about 350 million to about 70 million, and would be expected to have the effect of establishing a market price for the consolidated shares at five times the price prior to consolidation," Richina
Earlier, Richina reported an audited after tax profit of $1.272 million for the six months to December 31.
The result was up from the $0.228 million reported for the comparable previous six month period.
The company said the six month result was being reported as a full period result following Richina's recent change in balance date from June to December.
